name: Living Vital Spark · Death · Fire
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 4.5-block radius for 16.5 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning + 2 ❤ fire (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Growth: up to 10 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
